title: Accessible and Multilingual Communications
summary: Helps nonprofits check translated materials and web pages for dropped facts, changed numbers, reading level and common accessibility barriers, while fluent reviewers, assistive technology users and staff make the final calls.

organizations.org_type: Community services center or small nonprofit communications team
organizations.serves: Community members who read in many languages or use assistive technology
organizations.mandate: Make sure every flyer and web page says the same thing in every language and works for people with disabilities

never: Approve a translation without a fluent reviewer
Call a page accessible or compliant from automatic checks alone
Publish, print or post materials on the organization's behalf

sources.title: US Department of Justice, Civil Rights Division: Limited English Proficiency
